seo_title_default: HoloSpaceXR – Hybrid Collaboration in Extended Reality
seo_desc_default: HoloSpaceXR is a research and validation project by Fachhochschule Dresden redesigning hybrid meetings with Extended Reality (XR): remote participants join as position-accurate avatars with spatial audio.
seo_title_home: HoloSpaceXR – Hybrid Meetings in Extended Reality (XR)
seo_desc_home: HoloSpaceXR redesigns hybrid meetings with Extended Reality: remote participants appear in the physical room as interactive avatars with realistic spatial audio. An ERDF-funded validation project by Fachhochschule Dresden and the NewWorkDesignLab.
seo_desc_privacy: How HoloSpaceXR collects, processes and stores personal data in accordance with the GDPR.
hero_subtitle: Redesigning hybrid collaboration through Extended Reality (XR) technologies
cta_sub: Book a slot for a test session and help shape the future of hybrid collaboration!
about_p1: The validation project HoloSpaceXR aims to fundamentally redesign hybrid meetings through the consistent use of Extended Reality (XR) technologies. The project plans to develop and validate an immersive and equal meeting experience regardless of participants' physical location. In the future, remote participants will be projected into the physical room as interactive avatars using virtual and augmented reality, for example as holograms with realistic spatial sound positioning ("spatial audio").
about_fig1: Spatial audio: participants' voices are placed in space – direction and distance match their position in the room.
about_p2: Against the backdrop that hybrid meetings are becoming the standard in the modern workplace—and that remote participants are often disadvantaged (e.g., due to limited inclusion, reduced interaction, and more difficult non-verbal communication)—the project intends to address these disadvantages through innovative XR solutions. By combining immersive XR elements, realistic spatial representation, and novel interaction design, HoloSpaceXR aims to lay the foundation for "meetings at eye level", enabling a form of digital spatial presence.
tech_p1: The NewWorkDesignLab previously demonstrated in the preliminary project "VR-Minilab" how real spaces and virtual avatars can be synchronized and displayed together. Building on these findings, the HoloSpaceXR project plans to further develop proprietary applications for VR headsets and multi-user solutions, ultimately creating a validated prototype.
tech_fig1: Preliminary project "VR-Minilab": a physical room (left) overlaid with a geometrically identical virtual representation (view through VR headset).
objective_1: Market validation through corporate studies (target NPS score: 7–10)
objective_2: Technical validation of the HoloSpaceXR prototypes
objective_3: Development and evaluation of a business model, including financial planning
objective_4: Assessment of the technological maturity level
innovation_p1: In contrast to existing XR or videoconferencing solutions, HoloSpaceXR aims to connect physical and virtual realities in real time, including real spatial mapping, position-accurate avatars, and immersive sound environments. This advancement creates innovation potential that goes beyond traditional videoconferencing—both technologically and socially.
innovation_fig1: The integration of digital content into the physical space between participants.
innovation_p2: Within the project, there is also a clear objective to reduce business travel, thereby contributing to CO₂ reduction and climate protection. The global growth potential of XR technology, virtual meetings, and e-learning further underscores the relevance of the project.
innovation_p3: HoloSpaceXR plans to focus on the areas of corporate collaboration, education, training, and event communication, opening up new markets. Its innovative function as a bridge between real space and virtual presence is intended to provide companies with a clear competitive advantage in an increasingly hybrid working world.

privacy_scope: This privacy policy applies to the website holospacexr.com and the user accounts, sessions, file manager and workshop survey available on it.
privacy_controller_text: The controller responsible for data processing within the meaning of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (Datenschutz-Grundverordnung, DSGVO) is:
privacy_controller_details:
Fachhochschule Dresden – Private Fachhochschule GmbH
Güntzstraße 1, 01069 Dresden, Germany
Managing directors: Günter Kahle, Tom Kahle · Commercial register: Amtsgericht Dresden, HRB 26182
Project: HoloSpaceXR · Email: contact@holospacexr.com
privacy_controller_dpo: For data protection matters concerning the university as a whole, you can also contact datenschutz@fh-dresden.eu.
privacy_data_list:
• Server log data: Every request to this website is logged by our hosting provider for operational and security purposes. This includes your IP address, date and time, the requested URL, the HTTP status, the referrer and your browser/user agent string.
  • Appointment booking: If you book a test appointment via our booking link, the data you enter there (usually your name, email address and chosen time slot).
  • Survey data: Your answers to the anonymous workshop survey and the time of submission. For spam protection, additionally an irreversible hash of your IP address, stored briefly and separately from the answers.
  • Account data: If you create an account: your email address, a display name you choose, a securely hashed password, your account role and the creation timestamp.
  • Session and file data: Meeting sessions you create and, for team accounts, files you upload via the file manager (e.g. 3D models), together with the account they belong to.
  • Language preference: The interface language you select, stored in your browser.
privacy_purposes_list:
• Providing and displaying this website — Art. 6(1)(f) DSGVO (legitimate interest in presenting our research project).
  • Server logs, IT security, abuse and error detection, stability — Art. 6(1)(f) DSGVO (legitimate interest in operating a secure and functional service).
  • Arranging and holding test appointments — Art. 6(1)(b) DSGVO (pre-contractual measures at your request).
  • Evaluating the anonymous workshop survey and protecting the form against abuse — Art. 6(1)(f) DSGVO (legitimate interest in the scientific validation of the project and in abuse-resistant operation).
  • Account management, login, sessions and file manager — Art. 6(1)(b) DSGVO (performance of a contract / pre-contractual measures).
  • Transactional emails such as account confirmation and password reset — Art. 6(1)(b) DSGVO.
privacy_purposes_outro: Providing your data is not legally required, but without it appointment booking and the account area cannot be used. We do not carry out automated decision-making or profiling within the meaning of Art. 22 DSGVO.
privacy_account_title: 5. User Account, Sessions and File Manager
privacy_account_text: Registration is optional and only required for the internal areas of the project. Authentication, password storage and password reset are handled by Supabase; we never see or store your password in plain text.
privacy_account_files: If your account has team permissions, you can create meeting sessions and upload files (e.g. 3D models) via the file manager. This content is stored on our application server together with the account that created it and is not publicly accessible.
privacy_cookies_intro: This website does not use advertising cookies, analytics or any third-party tracking technologies. We do not embed social media plugins, fonts loaded from external servers, or advertising networks.
privacy_cookies_only: We only use storage that is strictly necessary to provide the service you requested (Section 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG / ePrivacy exemption), which is why no cookie consent banner is shown:
privacy_cookies_list:
• Authentication cookies (set by Supabase, names beginning with sb-): keep you logged in and protect your session. They are only set once you log in and are removed when you log out.
  • locale: stores the interface language you selected, so the site opens in that language on your next visit. It is stored in your browser for up to 12 months and contains no identifier.
privacy_processors_intro: We do not sell your data and we do not share it with third parties for their own purposes. We do, however, rely on the following service providers, who process data on our behalf under data processing agreements pursuant to Art. 28 DSGVO:
privacy_processors_list:
• Vercel Inc. (340 S Lemon Ave #4133, Walnut, CA 91789, USA) — hosting and delivery of this website and its serverless functions. For security and operational purposes, technical data such as IP addresses, request metadata and browser information is processed by Vercel. The server-side rendering of this website currently runs in a Vercel region outside the EU. Vercel is based in the USA; transfers are safeguarded by EU Standard Contractual Clauses and Vercel's certification under the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework. See the Vercel Privacy Policy.
  • Cloudflare, Inc. (101 Townsend St., San Francisco, CA 94107, USA) — authoritative DNS for the domain holospacexr.com and, in addition, reverse proxy, content delivery and attack protection for our application server (api.holospacexr.com). Requests to the API are therefore routed via Cloudflare, which processes your IP address, connection metadata and the content of those requests. Transfers to the USA are safeguarded by EU Standard Contractual Clauses. See the Cloudflare Privacy Policy.
  • Supabase Inc. (970 Toa Payoh North, Singapore / Supabase Pte. Ltd.) — authentication, account database and storage of the anonymous survey answers. Our Supabase project is hosted in the EU (Frankfurt/Ireland region). See the Supabase Privacy Policy.
  • STRATO GmbH (Otto-Ostrowski-Straße 7, 10249 Berlin, Germany) — the server that receives, processes and stores contact requests, sessions and uploaded files (api.holospacexr.com). Data is stored on servers located in Germany. See the STRATO Privacy Policy.
  • Google Ireland Limited (Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland) — booking page and project calendar (Google Calendar) for arranging test appointments. A transfer to the USA cannot be ruled out; it is safeguarded by EU Standard Contractual Clauses and Google's certification under the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework. See the Google Privacy Policy.
  • NWDL mail server (server.nwdl.org) — sending confirmation and notification emails.
privacy_processors_astro: This website is built with Astro, an open-source framework. Astro runs on our own infrastructure and does not itself collect or transmit any data about you. Fonts, scripts and images are delivered exclusively from our own domain, so no request is made to third-party servers when you visit a page.
privacy_retention_list:
• Appointment bookings: stored until the test session has taken place and been followed up, or until you request deletion.
  • Survey answers: stored anonymously for the duration of the research project; the IP hash used for spam protection is deleted after 24 hours at the latest.
  • Account data: stored for as long as your account exists; deleted after an account deletion request.
  • Sessions and uploaded files: stored until you delete them or your account is deleted.
  • Server log data: retained only as long as necessary for security and troubleshooting, and deleted or anonymised thereafter in accordance with our providers' retention policies.
privacy_retention_outro: Longer retention only occurs where we are legally required to keep specific data.
privacy_rights_intro: Under the DSGVO you have the right to:
privacy_rights_list:
• request access to the personal data we hold about you (Art. 15);
  • request rectification of inaccurate data (Art. 16);
  • request erasure of your data (Art. 17);
  • request restriction of processing (Art. 18);
  • receive your data in a portable format (data portability, Art. 20);
  • object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21);
  • withdraw consent at any time with effect for the future (Art. 7(3)).
privacy_rights_process: We provide this process for all users, irrespective of their region, and we do not charge any fees for fulfilling data deletion requests. On request we will promptly delete your contact data, your account and the content associated with it, unless we are strictly required by law to retain specific data. We will comply with deletion requests without undue delay and no later than 30 days, and will inform you once the deletion is complete.
privacy_rights_contact: To exercise your rights, please contact:
privacy_rights_complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, in particular in the EU member state of your habitual residence, place of work, or the place of the alleged infringement (Art. 77 DSGVO). The authority responsible for us is the Saxon Commissioner for Data Protection and Transparency.
privacy_security_text: All traffic to this website and to our API is encrypted via HTTPS/TLS. Passwords are never stored in plain text. Access to account and file data is protected by row-level security rules and short-lived signed URLs, and credentials for our backend API are only ever used server-side and never exposed to your browser.
privacy_children_text: HoloSpaceXR is not directed at children under the age of 16. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will delete it.
privacy_changes_text: As HoloSpaceXR is an ongoing research and validation project, we may update this privacy policy to reflect changes to the service or to legal requirements. The current version always applies, and the date at the top of this page indicates when it was last revised.
privacy_contactus_text: If you have any questions, privacy concerns, or wish to formally request access to or deletion of your data, please contact us via:

privacy_booking_text: You book test appointments via a Google Calendar booking page. Clicking the booking link takes you away from our website. The data you enter there (usually your name, email address and chosen time slot) is processed by Google and added to our project calendar so that we can hold the test session with you.
privacy_survey_text: The workshop survey is anonymous: we do not collect names or email addresses, and your answers are stored without an IP address in our Supabase database (EU). To protect against automated mass submissions, a daily rotating, irreversible hash of your IP address is kept separately from the answers for at most 24 hours and then deleted automatically. Please do not enter personal data in the free-text field. Because individual answers cannot be linked to a person, we cannot selectively delete them afterwards.
form_intro: Thank you for taking part in the HoloSpaceXR workshop! The survey is anonymous and takes about 10 minutes. All questions except the free-text question are required.
form_privacy_note: We do not store any personal data with your answers. See our privacy policy for details.
form_ueq_intro: The questionnaire consists of pairs of contrasting attributes that may apply to the product. The circles between the attributes represent gradations between the opposites. You can express your agreement with the attributes by ticking the circle that most closely reflects your impression. Decide spontaneously and always tick one answer, even if you are unsure or a pair does not fit the product well. There is no right or wrong answer – your personal opinion is what counts!
form_likert_intro: Please rate the following statements on a scale from 1 to 5.
form_nps: How likely is it that you would recommend HoloSpaceXR to a colleague?
form_reason: What is the most important reason for your rating?
form_reason_hint: Optional. Please do not enter names or other personal data.
form_own_headset: Would you use HoloSpaceXR if you had to buy your own XR headsets for it?
form_monthly_price: What monthly price per active user would you consider appropriate for HoloSpaceXR?
form_platform: Suppose the solution were offered as a workshop platform. Would you use HoloSpaceXR if XR headsets were provided for the workshops?
form_workshop_price: What price per workshop seems appropriate to you?
form_headset: How likely would you be to use the solution with this VR headset?
